title: Brief and review every slice against one hardening checklist
body:
Outcome: docs/program/hardening-checklist.md (symlinks, path traversal, malformed records, races, signals, size limits, error paths) is required as a ## Hardening section in every worker brief (preflight or brief-check refuses a brief without it) and is passed to krn review via --prepass --checklist in every delivery; an observer is red at base. Root cause of 48% of lost review attempts (lens-quality.md).
Evidence: .krn/runs/program-audit/synthesis.md (operator grant ./grant.md, 2026-11-01).
